sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 4 October 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000090-P1 was put before Silver Oak Medical Group 090 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 1.75 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Influenza preferred-position minimum of 65 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
